question: How many fundamental duties were originally listed in the Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is **10**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ten fundamental** responsibilities were initially identified.
 
• The **42nd amendment **added **Fundamental Duties** to the Indian Constitution.
 
• The **eleventh** responsibility was **added **as a result of the **86th** Constitutional** Amendment,** which was passed in **2002**.
 
• According to the **moral, ethical,** and cultural codes of conduct that individuals follow, there are 11 Fundamental **Duties** for Indian** Citizens**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• All people have a **moral duty** to support the **unity** of **India** and advance the cause of **patriotism**, which is what is meant by the term "**Fundamental Duties**."
 
• These **obligations**, outlined in **Part IV-A (Article 51A) **of the **Constitution**, affect both people and the country.
 
• **Indian citizens** are reminded of their **obligations** to society, their fellow citizens, and the country.
 
• Citizens are cautioned against engaging in anti-social and **anti-national behavior**.
 
• They** motivate** people and **encourage** a sense of commitment and **discipline **among them.
